about: Every identifier-shaped match the identifier gate finds in tracked source (scripts/, src/, test/), each with its reason. Keyed by file, kind and the sha256 of the matched text (never the text). The standing test (test/unit/source-identifiers.test.mjs) requires the findings to equal this list exactly: a new finding fails, and so does a listed one that is gone. Edit this list directly, with a reason; never regenerate it to make a finding pass.
